name: Capital One Spark Miles for Business

localized_names.en: Capital One Spark Miles for Business

base_rate.description: 2X miles on every purchase (predecessor earn rate).

rewards.redemption_notes: Miles redeemed through Capital One Travel or transferred to partners.

notes: Capital One's April 14, 2026 announcement explicitly states that Spark Miles will now be known as Venture Business. This record preserves the predecessor brand and its historical terms; the announcement does not establish an exact withdrawal date. The former generic credit-card catalog source did not document this predecessor or its rebrand. No successor artwork is used. Historical artwork provenance (checked 2026-10-21): the retained 2018-07-16 archive of the official Capital One Spark Miles product page lists the Spark Miles product (brand codes SPARKMILES and SPARKMILESTS) with the image sparkmiles-card-art.png. The linked image resolves to a 2018-10-28 archive capture of that Capital One-hosted asset and was visually inspected as the blue Spark Business Visa Signature card. It is a low-resolution 300x189 historical image documenting the predecessor brand as marketed at that date; it is not evidence of lifecycle or the financial fields, which were not reverified in this artwork-only update.
